name: Astral Voice [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "A symptom of staying in Hollows for too long, it's damaged your hearing." The doctor has given a strict warning that if I don't want to go deaf, I had better never go into a Hollow again. Welp... no can do. While my Proxy career is important, but having enough hearing to listen to Astra Yao's new song is more important.

name: Astral Voice [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: I couldn't help it, I ended up accepting a job where I had to go into a Hollow. Like expected, the doctor was mad when I came for another check-up. This time the doctor told me that my hearing wasn't normal for someone my age and if I didn't take care of myself, I'd end up completely deaf within two months... Alright, alright, looks like I'd really be better off switching jobs...

secondaryDescription: I met a group of super outgoing girls at Astra's album signing. Though we're pretty far apart in age, we have endless things to say when it comes to Astra. I even agreed to go check out their place sometime.

description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Birdsong dances with the shade of trees,
The flowers sway in the afternoon breeze.
Sunlight sneaks, unnoticed by all,

The moment when our worlds first collide.

name: Shadow Harmony [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
A sturdy hand, a gentle touch,
A smiling face, loving so much.
Something's stirring, a dream yet so young,
Your name is murmured, softly sung.
You can't understand it, so I'll tell you the way,
Each whisper's a part of my life today.

name: Shadow Harmony [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Even with laughter mocking in my ear,
I follow your steps, year after year.
The pain of falling belongs to yesterday.
No matter where we go, what dangers may lay,
You haven't spoken, so I'll describe.
I'll run ahead of you, all my life.

name: Shadow Harmony [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
I seek you out when there's no one near,
In those times, your loneliness is clear.
We both sigh, gazing at the streetlamp's light,
But you never lift your head to face your own fight.
You never see it, so let me describe,
No matter who you wish to be, your shadow's your guide.

name: Shadow Harmony [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
When you pick up your helmet and sword,
I wrap myself in shadows, my heart ignored.
When you wave goodbye to your love so true,
I stand beneath the lamp, weeping too.
You're driven by ideals, so here's what I'll say,
The person you dream of may not be that way.

name: Shadow Harmony [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Your reason fades, it falls away,
Like madness creeping, here to stay.
Your twisted arms grow fierce and tight,
Like danger lurking out of sight.
You've locked yourself in endless night,
Where even I can't reach your light.
You shut me out, you look away,
So let me speak before I stray...
When light returns and breaks the gloom,
Your shadow slips back into view.
No matter what, love, hate, or fear,
I'll stay right here—I'm always near.

The Mini Cargo Truck: Your sturdiest safety net. A general logistics vehicle used by the HIA to deliver all kinds of supplies to aid investigators in harvesting Ether resources. Some lost Mini Cargo Trucks will end up as a sweet bonus for Hollow Raiders looking around for loot.
If you see a lost Mini Cargo Truck, please use whatever is inside as you see fit... It's not like they'll fight back.

name: Fortune's Tea Pet

"Hold onto your 'Fortune's Tea Pet' and sip some tea - it'll bring you luck in everything you do!"

After the manufacturing company's unfortunate closure following the fall of the old capital, these sets became increasingly rare. Today, a small number of enthusiasts still collect them.

name: Notes From the Chained
secondaryDescription:
A mysterious track posted on Inter-Knot by an anonymous creator, inspired by the hallucinations of a lost Hollow wanderer. The melody cuts off abruptly halfway through, yet its hauntingly precise evocation of the despair and disorientation of deep Hollow exploration made it a brief sensation.
It is said that an investigator, once lost, abandoned rescue efforts and instead followed the melody as his guide, wandering within the Hollow. The agony brought on by Corruption nearly blinded him, yet the tune continued to echo in his ears. In the end, he miraculously found a way out.
Later, this investigator who returned from the abyss became a well-known composer and finished writing the second half of the melody.

name: "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun
description:
A machine gun can be implanted on Tully's chest, firing out <color=#E48600>powerful projectiles</color>, but with a <color=#E48600>limited magazine capacity</color>. After firing all bullets in the magazine, it will <color=#E48600>reload</color>, and once reloaded can <color=#E48600>continue attacking</color>.

With each <color=#E48600>reload</color>, Tully will load projectiles corresponding to an attribute type of a randomly selected Agent in the squad.

Can be upgraded using <color=#E48600>Projectile Dreamland Resonium</color> obtained from the <color=#E48600>modification workshop</color>.

name: "Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box
description:
Missile pods that can be installed on Tully's shoulders that will launch <color=#E48600>auto-tracking missiles</color> that automatically fire a small number of missiles at intervals during combat.

When an Agent activates their <color=#E48600>EX Special Attack</color>, it will use <color=#E48600>Maximum Firepower</color> to launch a massive missile barrage.

Can be upgraded using <color=#E48600>Shadow Pursuit Dreamland Resonium</color> obtained from the <color=#E48600>modification workshop</color>.

name: [Attack: Eradication] Masquerade
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Hugo accumulates Energy over time. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Hugo to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. This skill always CRITs, and when a heavy attack from this skill hits an enemy, it <color=#FFFFFF>triggers the Totalize effect</color>, dealing <color=#2BAD00>DMG equal to 100%/20%/10% of the target's Max HP</color> to normal enemies/Elite enemies/Boss enemies respectively. When Hugo's <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> hits a Stunned enemy, it ends the enemy's Stunned state and deals <color=#2BAD00>additional DMG equal to a percentage of Max HP</color> to Elite enemies/Boss enemies based on remaining Daze duration, up to an additional 20%/10%.

name: Model: Frostfall Sickle
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
A limited-edition toy crafted to mimic a W-Engine.

Clutching a wavering ideal.
Running and shouting across the barren red earth, then falling into sleep, only to wake up grown.
Choosing chains of one's own making.
Living on as a blade, scraping by. Investigating, interrogating, hunting... endless, numb, cold.
Waiting for the promised judgment.
Plucking a rotting new bud and stepping into winter, until at last welcoming life's final hope... death, warm and peaceful.

name: Model: Starlight Rider Faceplate
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
A limited-edition toy crafted to mimic a W-Engine.

What is a knight?
The crimson knight says, "Carrying out the justice in my heart!" The amber knight says, "Dealing with each sin in this world!" The verdant knight says, "Protecting everyone's hope!"
So what is a knight, in the end? The advanced tactical construct suddenly falls into serious thought over this profound question, no different from the philosophers who have long pondered the ultimate meaning of existence.
Regrettably, this great and noble meditation on chivalric aesthetics is cut short in under ten seconds by an unceremonious interruption from a companion.
"Billy, you've watched 'Starlight Knight: A Knight's Proof' a hundred times already. So what even is the proof?"
"I'll know when I've watched it another hundred times!"
—At the Cunning Hares' place, two people arguing over the remote.

name: Letter From Xiao'Guang
description: Ye Shunguang had left some old belongings in Failume Heights, but thankfully with your help, they were all recovered. To show gratitude, Xiao'Guang left you a letter explaining the origins of these items — it seems he has something special he wants to tell you...
secondaryDescription: Attached to the letter was a delicate feather, a group photo of the Yunkui Summit folks, a broken peace knot, a heavily revised recipe, a handwritten guide for Yunkui Summit newcomers, and a burnt-out floating lantern... These old items carry Xiao'Guang's cherished memories of Yunkui Summit, and she hopes you can keep them safe for her.
